paper text.text: Before combining the forms, remove any having a proper minor that preserves its neighborhood and the required connectivity, and preserves which of the four completions are planar for $D_c,D_d$ or keeps $H_1+ac+ad$ nonplanar for $D_1$. Such a reduction would give a proper allowed minor of $B$ keeping all four tests nonplanar. For separate components $D_c,D_d$, combine their retained forms with each of the eleven forms of $B_0$ and each permitted subset of $\{aw,bw\}$, or with the two single vertices. For one component $D_1$, combine its retained form with those two vertices. The reductions above show that $G$ occurs among these combinations. The records in~\supp{E11} give $33$ remaining forms for $D_c$, $54$ for $D_1$, and all their combinations. Keeping those with $B$ planar leaves $1{,}471$ candidates. The checks leave exactly three obstructions, $\mathfrak T_{56},\mathfrak T_{72},\mathfrak T_{73}$, all with one component $D_0$.

vertex names: Psi_2: twins p, q with neighbourhood {a,b,c} and r, z with {a,b,d}. X = {a,b,w}. Interior vertices: U* in B_0, C* in D_c, D* in D_d, R* in D_1, k1, k2 the two singleton components.

subcases.a: one component D_0 with bridge B_0, and the components D_c, D_d
subcases.b: two singleton components with neighbourhood {a,b,w}, and D_c, D_d
subcases.c: two singleton components with neighbourhood {a,b,w}, and the common component D_1

construction of D_c: with all four graphs H_c + E planar, at most two single vertices on c, w and some of a, b, with or without cw; otherwise Construction 3.17 with attachments a, b, c, w, added edges ab, aw, bw and E (E = {ac}, {bc} or {ac, bc}, required), original pair cw as an edge or a once-subdivided segment, or on the quotient (H_c + ac + bc)/ab with every lift of the edges at the identified vertex; every interior component given its neighbours at c and w, and at most two further single vertices for missing neighbours at a, b
construction of D_1: Construction 3.17 with attachments a, c, d, w, added edges ac, ad, aw, the subdivision using ac or ad, original pairs cw, dw as an edge or a once-subdivided segment; the interior pieces divided into components in every way and joined by every forest; then at most two further single vertices, each adjacent to w and to c or d (and possibly a), and every inclusion-minimal set of attaching edges from the retained components that makes every interior component meet w and c or d, joins c and d through the interior, and, for N(D_1) = {a,w}, gives a an interior neighbour; the whole configuration minimal. Both N(D_1) = {w} and {a,w}.
reduction: forms with a one-step proper minor of the same signature (neighbourhood and planar completions) that meets the same conditions are removed before combination
B: B is G minus p, q, r, z and the edges among a, b, c, d. Each candidate is a class of isomorphic assembled graphs, recorded by a member whose B is planar whenever the class has one, and gives a plane rotation system of B or a Kuratowski subgraph of it. The candidates with B planar are those retained in Section 5.4.
